description_en: Queries the performance metrics of data sharing
description_zh: 查看数据共享的性能指标
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb describe-data-share-performance --resource-group-id example-string --key adbpg_datashare_topic_count --start-time 2022-08-03T15:00Z --end-time 2022-08-03T15:10Z --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDataSharePerformance

parameters.description_en:
The name of the performance metric. To specify multiple metrics, separate the metric names with a comma (,). Valid values:

- **adbpg\_datashare\_topic\_count**: the number of shared topics.

- **adbpg\_datashare\_data\_size\_mb**: the size of shared data in MB.
parameters.description_zh:
性能参数名称，多个指标用英文半角（,）分隔，取值如下：

- **adbpg_datashare_topic_count**：共享Topic数量。
- **adbpg_datashare_data_size_mb**：数据共享数据量。
